title: 第1634章 真正的空间法则威力第1633章 实力暴涨的苏忘机
slug: 凡人修仙开局看守草药场
content_zh:
“该死！我要撕了这只人族蝼蚁，为共首领报仇！”
眼看共沧渊的无头尸身，就要坠落地面，祝青锋身形极速飞掠而去，将其收入自己的储物空间，他没有立刻返回，手中赤红光芒闪烁，一根燃烧着火焰的古朴长鞭，迎风而起，化作千丈鞭影，朝着苏忘机卷去。
“回来！”
“撤！”
两道声音同时响起，一道来自帝塔，另一道却是从苏星河口中发出。
苏忘机本就没打算继续与对方缠斗，一剑斩杀共沧渊，看似不费吹灰之力，体内法力，实则已经消耗过甚，抓住飞剑的一瞬间，便朝大阵冲去。
先前为了斩杀老妪，苏星河以空间法则，带动整个大阵瞬移笼罩了巫族几人，此时双方距离不过百丈距离，眼看祝青锋贸然闯入，他提醒苏忘机后撤，自己却是主动迎了上去。
手中五彩光芒凝聚，剑光直接朝着对方赤红鞭影绞杀而去。
有过与青山真君对战的经验，苏星河对这赤红长鞭并不陌生，据当初青山真君所言，这古朴长鞭，乃是他们一族的圣器，只是，他不清楚，祝青锋使用的这只长鞭，是否是青山真君的那一条。
剑光与鞭影交织的瞬间，苏星河并未催动全力，控制着飞剑的威力，保持不被对方击溃，营造出旗鼓相当的局面，体内却是在暗中融合火、土双属性之力，只待他栖身而上，便给予必杀一击！
可惜，他这个想法最终还是落空了。
祝青锋一鞭抽过，没有拦住苏忘机，也没有继续追击，听从帝塔的吩咐，抽身返回。
“先脱离大阵笼罩！”
帝塔皱眉看向头顶阵法光幕，阵法延绵万丈，此时阵法中不存在任何束缚之力，甚至，连一丝负面效果都没有，但他心中却是清楚，这阵法最强的不是束缚，而是对攻击杀力的极致加持！
也正因没有复杂的阵法效果，才会有如此纯粹的力量加持，能够斩杀巫灵降临状态下的巫族强者，足以说明阵法的恐怖！
“现在想走，是不是晚了！？”
苏星河与封仪对视，二人同时催动体内法力，加持在阵法之上，包括封岳、封极，都没有任何动作，整个紫薇斩仙大阵，却是再次暴涨。
而阵法光幕之上，若有若无的水波浮现，却是封仪再次展开了碧海潮生大阵。
与先前不同的是，此时的碧海潮生大阵，乃是有苏星河的加持。
“小小阵法，也想困住本首领？！”

帝塔嘴硬，但先前脸上的轻蔑与得意，早已消失的无影无踪，面容虽然仍旧狰狞，却是多出几分凝重。
很显然，他已经看清眼下的局势，非但没了绝对的实力压制，反而隐隐处于下风。
尤其是苏忘机展现出的强大杀力，再加上眼前紫薇斩仙大阵的强大威力，面对他们仅剩的三人，胜负已经难以判断了。
“破！”
帝塔法相背后双翼展开，依旧是那标志性的空间撕裂，羽翼光芒所过之处，空间寸寸坍塌，漆黑空洞的空间乱流，让每一个看到的人，都会忍不住惊叹啧舌。
可惜，苏星河早已摸清了他的术法特点，在他挥动羽翼的同时，千重叠影的空间术法，再次施展。
content_en:
"Damn it! I'm going to tear this human ant apart and avenge the leader of the Communist Party!"
Seeing that the headless body of Gong Cangyuan was about to fall to the ground, Zhu Qingfeng flew away at high speed and put it into his storage space. He did not return immediately. The red light flashed in his hand, and a simple long whip burning with flames rose in the wind, turned into a thousand-foot whip shadow, and rolled towards Su Wangji.
"Come back!"
"Withdraw!"
Two voices sounded at the same time, one coming from the Imperial Tower, and the other coming from the mouth of the Su Xing River.
Su Wangji had no intention of continuing to fight with the opponent. He killed Gong Cangyuan with one sword. It seemed effortless, but the mana in his body was actually exhausted. The moment he grabbed the flying sword, he rushed towards the formation.
In order to kill the old woman, Su Xinghe used the law of space to teleport the entire formation to cover the Wu clan. At this time, the distance between the two sides was only a hundred feet away. Seeing Zhu Qingfeng rush in, he reminded Su Wangji to retreat, but he took the initiative to greet him.
The five-colored light condensed in his hand, and the sword light strangled directly towards the opponent's red whip shadow.
Having had the experience of fighting against True Lord Qingshan, Su Xinghe was no stranger to this crimson whip. According to True Lord Qingshan, this ancient whip was the sacred weapon of their clan. However, he did not know whether the whip used by Zhu Qingfeng was the one belonging to True Lord Qingshan.
At the moment when the sword light and the whip shadow intertwined, Su Xinghe did not use all his strength, but controlled the power of the flying sword to avoid being defeated by the opponent, creating a situation of equal strength. However, he secretly combined the power of fire and earth attributes in his body. Just wait for him to perch on the ground, and give him a killing blow!
Unfortunately, his idea ultimately came to nothing.
Zhu Qingfeng whipped Su Wangji, but did not stop Su Wangji or continue the pursuit. He obeyed Di Ta's instructions and pulled back.
"Get out of the big formation first!"
Di Ta frowned and looked at the formation light screen above his head. The formation stretched for thousands of miles. At this time, there was no binding power in the formation, and there was not even a trace of negative effects. But he knew in his heart that the strongest thing about this formation was not the restraint, but the ultimate blessing of attack power!
It is precisely because there are no complicated formation effects that there is such a pure power blessing, and it can kill the powerful witch clan when the witch spirit descends, which is enough to illustrate the terror of the formation!
"I want to leave now, is it too late!?"
Su Xinghe and Feng Yi looked at each other. They both activated their magic power at the same time to support the formation. Even Feng Yue and Feng Ji did not make any move. However, the entire Ziwei Immortal Slaying Formation surged again.
But above the light screen of the formation, faint waves appeared, but it was Feng Yi who once again launched the Blue Sea Tidal Formation.
The difference from before was that the blue sea tide formation at this time was blessed by Su Xinghe.
"This small formation also wants to trap this leader?!"
Di Ta's mouth was tough, but the previous contempt and pride on his face had long since disappeared without a trace. Although his face was still ferocious, it was a bit more solemn.
Obviously, he has clearly seen the current situation. Not only does he no longer have the absolute strength to suppress it, he is actually at a slight disadvantage.
Especially the powerful killing power displayed by Su Wangji, coupled with the powerful power of the Ziwei Immortal Killing Formation in front of him, facing the only three of them, it was already difficult to judge the outcome.
"Broken!"
The wings on the back of the Imperial Tower are spread out, and there is still the iconic tearing of space. Wherever the light of the wings passes, the space collapses inch by inch, and the dark and empty space flows turbulently. Everyone who sees it can't help but gasp in amazement.
Unfortunately, Su Xinghe had already figured out the characteristics of his technique. As he waved his wings, a thousand overlapping space techniques were used again.
